# Heartland Acquisitions

> Heartland Acquisitions is a Kansas City cash home-buying company. We buy houses as-is in any condition across the Kansas City metro on both the Missouri and Kansas sides of the state line. No fees, no commissions, no repairs, no showings. Cash offers within 1 hour of walkthrough. Closing in as little as 7 days.

We are a family-owned business operated by Ivarix Capital LLC (DBA Heartland Acquisitions). We are the actual buyer, not a wholesaler — we purchase properties with our own funds, then renovate and either rent or resell them.

## Service area

Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line: Jackson, Clay, Cass, and Platte counties (Missouri); Wyandotte and Johnson counties (Kansas). Cities include Kansas City MO, Independence, Lee's Summit, Blue Springs, Raytown, Grandview, Belton, Liberty, Gladstone, Kansas City KS, Overland Park, Olathe, Shawnee, and Lenexa.

## What we buy

Single-family homes, duplexes, and small multi-family properties. Vacant, occupied, tenanted, condemned, fire-damaged, hoarder, or distressed houses — we make fair offers on all conditions.

## How offers are calculated

We look at comparable properties recently sold in the seller's neighborhood, factor in the home's condition and any updates, then account for our holding and renovation costs plus a fair margin.

## What sellers don't pay

No commissions. No listing fees. No closing costs charged to the seller. No repair costs. No cleaning costs (sellers can leave anything they don't want).
